title: Does Cross-Cultural Alignment Change the Commonsense Morality of Language Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning Japanese LLMs on Japanese (JCommonsenseMorality) and English (ETHICS) commonsense morality datasets, including their translated cross-lingual counterparts, and evaluating the models' accuracy on culture-specific moral judgments to determine if aligning with English-centric preference data marginalizes Japanese cultural values.
